## Calculated Values {#sec-calculated}

Parameters derived from mathematical formulas and economic models.

### dFDA Trial Cost Reduction Factor: 44.1x {#sec-dfda_trial_cost_reduction_factor}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Cost reduction factor projected for dFDA pragmatic trials ($41K traditional / $1,200 dFDA = 34x)

**Inputs**:

- [Phase 3 Cost per Patient](#sec-traditional_phase3_cost_per_patient) 📊: $41K (95% CI: $20K - $120K)
- [dFDA Pragmatic Trial Cost per Patient](#sec-dfda_pragmatic_trial_cost_per_patient) 📊: $929 (95% CI: $97 - $3K)

$$
\begin{gathered}
k_{reduce} \\
= \frac{Cost_{P3,pt}}{Cost_{pragmatic,pt}} \\
= \frac{\$41K}{\$929} \\
= 44.1
\end{gathered}
$$

**Methodology**: [../appendix/dfda-impact-paper#cost-reduction](../appendix/dfda-impact-paper#cost-reduction)

*✓ High confidence*

### Total Deaths from Historical Progress Delays: 98.4M deaths {#sec-existing_drugs_efficacy_lag_deaths_total}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Total deaths from delaying existing drugs over 8.2-year efficacy lag. One-time impact of eliminating Phase 2-4 testing delay for drugs already approved 1962-2024. Based on 12M deaths/year rate × 8.2 years. Excludes innovation acceleration effects.

**Inputs**:

- [Regulatory Delay for Efficacy Testing Post-Safety Verification](#sec-efficacy_lag_years) 📊: 8.2 years (SE: ±2 years)

$$
\begin{gathered}
Deaths_{lag,total} \\
= T_{lag} \times 12000000 \\
= 8.2 \times 12000000 \\
= 98.4M
\end{gathered}
$$

**Methodology**: [../appendix/invisible-graveyard#historical-progress](../appendix/invisible-graveyard#historical-progress)

*✓ High confidence*

### RECOVERY Trial Cost Reduction Factor: 82x {#sec-recovery_trial_cost_reduction_factor}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Cost reduction factor demonstrated by RECOVERY trial ($41K traditional / $500 RECOVERY = 82x)

**Inputs**:

- [Phase 3 Cost per Patient](#sec-traditional_phase3_cost_per_patient) 📊: $41K (95% CI: $20K - $120K)
- [Recovery Trial Cost per Patient](#sec-recovery_trial_cost_per_patient) 📊: $500 (95% CI: $400 - $2.50K)

$$
\begin{gathered}
k_{RECOVERY} \\
= \frac{Cost_{P3,pt}}{Cost_{RECOVERY,pt}} \\
= \frac{\$41K}{\$500} \\
= 82
\end{gathered}
$$

**Methodology**: [@recovery-trial-82x-cost-reduction]

*✓ High confidence*

### Annual Global Clinical Trial Participants: 1.90M patients/year {#sec-current_trial_slots_available}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Annual global clinical trial participants (IQVIA 2022: 1.9M post-COVID normalization)

**Source**: [@global-trial-participant-capacity]

#### Uncertainty Range

**Technical**: 95% CI: [1.50M patients/year, 2.30M patients/year] • Distribution: Lognormal

**What this means**: This estimate has moderate uncertainty. The true value likely falls between 1.50M patients/year and 2.30M patients/year (±21%). This represents a reasonable range that our Monte Carlo simulations account for when calculating overall uncertainty in the results.

*The lognormal distribution means values can't go negative and have a longer tail toward higher values (common for costs and populations).*

#### Input Distribution

### dFDA Pragmatic Trial Cost per Patient: $929 {#sec-dfda_pragmatic_trial_cost_per_patient}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

dFDA pragmatic trial cost per patient. Uses ADAPTABLE trial ($929) as DELIBERATELY CONSERVATIVE central estimate. Harvard meta-analysis of 108 trials found median of only $97/patient - our estimate may overstate costs by 10x. Confidence interval spans meta-analysis median to complex chronic disease trials.

**Source**: [@pragmatic-trials-cost-advantage]

#### Uncertainty Range

**Technical**: 95% CI: [$97, $3K] • Distribution: Lognormal

**What this means**: This estimate is highly uncertain. The true value likely falls between $97 and $3K (±156%). This represents a very wide range that our Monte Carlo simulations account for when calculating overall uncertainty in the results.

*The lognormal distribution means values can't go negative and have a longer tail toward higher values (common for costs and populations).*

#### Input Distribution

{{< include ../figures/distribution-dfda_pragmatic_trial_cost_per_patient.qmd >}}

*~ Medium confidence*

:::

### Regulatory Delay for Efficacy Testing Post-Safety Verification: 8.2 years {#sec-efficacy_lag_years}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Regulatory delay for efficacy testing (Phase II/III) post-safety verification. Based on BIO 2021 industry survey. Note: This is for drugs that COMPLETE the pipeline - survivor bias means actual delay for any given disease may be longer if candidates fail and must restart.

**Source**: [@bio-clinical-development-2021]

#### Uncertainty Range

**Technical**: Distribution: Normal (SE: 2 years)

### RECOVERY Trial Global Lives Saved: 1.00M lives {#sec-recovery_trial_global_lives_saved}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Estimated lives saved globally by RECOVERY trial's dexamethasone discovery. NHS England estimate (March 2021). Based on Águas et al. Nature Communications 2021 methodology applying RECOVERY trial mortality reductions (36% ventilated, 18% oxygen) to global COVID hospitalizations. Wide uncertainty range reflects extrapolation assumptions.

**Source**: [@recovery-trial-1m-lives-saved]

**Technical**: 95% CI: [500k lives, 2.00M lives] • Distribution: Lognormal

**What this means**: This estimate is highly uncertain. The true value likely falls between 500k lives and 2.00M lives (±75%). This represents a very wide range that our Monte Carlo simulations account for when calculating overall uncertainty in the results.

## Core Definitions {#sec-definitions}

Fundamental parameters and constants used throughout the analysis.

### Stage 1 Observational Analysis Cost per Patient: $0.100 {#sec-dfda_observational_cost_per_patient}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Order-of-magnitude estimate for Stage 1 observational signal detection (PIS calculation). Validated by FDA Sentinel benchmark (~$1/patient/year for similar drug safety analysis at 100M+ scale). True cost varies with scale and complexity; exact value less important than order-of-magnitude difference vs pragmatic trials (~$500-929/patient) and traditional Phase 3 (~$41,000/patient).

#### Uncertainty Range

**Technical**: 95% CI: [$0.030, $1.00] • Distribution: Lognormal

**What this means**: This estimate is highly uncertain. The true value likely falls between $0.030 and $1.00 (±485%). This represents a very wide range that our Monte Carlo simulations account for when calculating overall uncertainty in the results.

*The lognormal distribution means values can't go negative and have a longer tail toward higher values (common for costs and populations).*

#### Input Distribution

{{< include ../figures/distribution-dfda_observational_cost_per_patient.qmd >}}

*Core definition*

:::

```{=html}
<script>
// Conservative lazy loading: only load images actually in viewport
(function() {
  'use strict';
  
  let imageObserver = null;
  let loadTimeout = null;
  
  function enableLazyLoading() {
    const images = document.querySelectorAll('img');
    
    // Use Intersection Observer with conservative threshold
    // rootMargin: '50px' means only load images within 50px of viewport
    // This prevents loading images passed through during hash navigation
    imageObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries, observer) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting && entry.intersectionRatio > 0) {
          const img = entry.target;
          // Only load if image is actually visible (not just passed through)
          if (img.dataset.src) {
            img.src = img.dataset.src;
            img.removeAttribute('data-src');
          } else if (!img.hasAttribute('loading')) {
            // For images without data-src, use native lazy loading
            img.setAttribute('loading', 'lazy');
          }
          observer.unobserve(img);
        }
      });
    }, {
      rootMargin: '50px',  // Only load images within 50px of viewport
      threshold: 0.01      // Trigger when at least 1% visible
    });
    
    images.forEach(img => {
      imageObserver.observe(img);
    });
  }
  
  // Handle hash navigation (clicking links to sections)
  // Delay loading to avoid loading images passed through during jump
  function handleHashNavigation() {
    if (loadTimeout) clearTimeout(loadTimeout);
    // Wait 300ms after navigation to let scroll settle
    // Images will load naturally via Intersection Observer when visible
    loadTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
      // Scroll has settled, Intersection Observer will handle visible images
      // No action needed - observer is already watching
    }, 300);
  }
  
  // Initialize on page load
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', enableLazyLoading);
  } else {
    enableLazyLoading();
  }
  
  // Handle hash changes (clicking anchor links)
  window.addEventListener('hashchange', handleHashNavigation);
  
  // Also handle initial hash if page loads with one
  if (window.location.hash) {
    setTimeout(handleHashNavigation, 100);
  }
})();
</script>
```
